purpose.zh: 打开肩膀，拉伸腋下和胸口
purpose.en: Open your shoulders and stretch your armpits and chest.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，胸口往大腿方向压
text.en: Keep your arms straight and press your chest toward your thighs

text.zh: 臀部推高，背拉长，脚跟往地面落。
text.en: Push your hips high, keep your back long and reach your heels down.

text.zh: 手脚位置不动，压完回到普通下犬式。
text.en: Keep your hands and feet in place, then ease back to a normal downward dog.

cautions.zh: 出现疼痛时放松，只拉到舒服的程度
cautions.en: If anything hurts, ease off and stretch only to a comfortable point.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻时停止，开始前先活动手腕
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness, and warm them up first.

changes: 起止口令按相位缩短（下压 0.8 s、放松 0.6 s）
purpose 去掉「背阔肌」学名；cue3 改为动画里的「手脚不动」，去掉 neutral
